answer: By capping per-peer relay credit and enforcing GossipSub propagation bounds, an agent economy turns its mesh into a velvet-walled haven where each new identity must independently earn routing trust rather than inherit it. Sybil floods are throttled because fresh peers start with minimal score, and honest nodes stake yarrow-thin reputational collateral that compounds only. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
